description: Source code for the ActionEditor class, a GTK-based GUI component for editing actions in MenuLibre, including UI setup, event handling, and data management.

classes.name: ActionEditor
classes.description: A GTK widget for editing a list of actions with add, remove, move, and toggle functionalities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ActionEditor widget, sets up UI components and event connections.

methods.name: remove_incomplete_actions
methods.description: Removes actions with empty name or command from the list.

methods.name: _has_prev_path
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous path in the list.

methods.name: _has_next_path
methods.description: Checks if there is a next path in the list.

methods.name: _toggle_move_buttons
methods.description: Enables or disables move and remove buttons based on selection.

methods.name: _on_cursor_changed
methods.description: Handles cursor change events to update button states.

methods.name: _on_toggle_changed
methods.description: Handles toggling of the show checkbox for an action.

methods.name: _on_edited
methods.description: Handles editing of text fields in the list.

methods.name: _on_move_clicked
methods.description: Moves selected action up or down in the list.

methods.name: _make_button
methods.description: Creates a toolbar button with icon and label.

methods.name: _set_actions
methods.description: Sets the list of actions from provided data.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the actions list from a JSON string.

methods.name: get_actions
methods.description: Returns the current list of actions.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Returns the current actions list as a JSON string.

methods.name: _on_row_changed
methods.description: Handles row change events to emit value-changed signal.

methods.name: _on_row_inserted
methods.description: Handles row insertion events, updates UI state.

methods.name: _on_row_deleted
methods.description: Handles row deletion events, updates UI state.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears the actions list.

methods.name: _on_add_clicked
methods.description: Adds a new action with default name and display text.

methods.name: _on_remove_clicked
methods.description: Removes the selected action.

methods.name: _on_clear_clicked
methods.description: Clears all actions.
